entrypoints.snapshot: scripts/mirror.py snapshot URL -o DIR [--sockets N --robots 0..3 --max-time S --resume --allow-private --json]
entrypoints.mirror: scripts/mirror.py mirror URL -o DIR [--depth N --sockets N --robots 0..3 --allow GLOB --deny GLOB --max-time S --max-mb N --resume --allow-private --json]

policy.network: outbound http/https only to URLs the caller supplies
policy.filesystem_writes: only inside the caller-specified -o output directory
policy.scan_patterns: +/- prefixes assigned by the wrapper; spaces rejected
